title: Theorem prover Arend
abstract: arXiv:2610.27264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper is an exposition of the theorem prover Arend developed at JetBrains Research. Arend language has been designed to facilitate the formalization of mathematics within the framework of univalent foundations and with the focus on constructive mathematics. It is based on a variant of homotopy type theory with cubical syntax that is more closely aligned with Martin-L\"of Type Theory (MLTT) than fully computational cubical type theories, while still retaining some of their computational properties useful in practice. Among the most notable features of the Arend language is its powerful system of classes and records supporting subsumptive subtyping, partial implementations and anonymous extensions, which provides extensive flexibility for constructing hierarchies of definitions. translated_abstract: 本文是对 JetBrains Research 开发的定理证明器 Arend 的介绍。Arend 语言旨在促进单价基础（univalent foundations）框架下的数学形式化，并专注于构造性数学。它基于一种带有立方语法（cubical syntax）的同伦类型论变体，与完全可计算的立方类型论相比，该变体更贴近 Martin-Löf 类型论（MLTT），同时仍保留了后者在实践中一些有用的计算性质。Arend 语言最显著的特征之一是其强大的类与记录系统，支持包含式子类型（subsumptive subtyping）、部分实现和匿名扩展，这为构建定义的层次结构提供了极大的灵活性。IntelliJ Arend 插件简化了 Arend 中的形式化工作，它将 IntelliJ IDEA 转变为一个功能完备的集成开发环境（IDE）。
tldr: JetBrains Research 开发的定理证明器 Arend 基于带立方语法的同伦类型论变体，凭借强大的类与记录系统和 IntelliJ 插件支持，为单价基础和构造性数学的形式化提供了灵活高效的语言与环境。
en_tdlr: The Arend theorem prover, developed at JetBrains Research, is based on a variant of homotopy type theory with cubical syntax and offers a powerful class/record system with IntelliJ plugin support, providing a flexible environment for formalizing mathematics within univalent foundations with a focus on constructive mathematics.
